liebermann.description_de: Vorlage von A und Quadr für Cn
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of A and the Quadripartitus, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.notes: A common source of A and the Quadripartitus for Cnut’s laws, posited by Liebermann.

others.text: Wormald (1999, p. 351) doubts that any such stemma can be drawn for Cnut’s code, which attracted variants from every side; he prefers to speak of a “post-conquest vulgate”.
